sources.title: USGS FDSN Event API documentation
sources.supports: CSV access; UTC and inclusive API endtime; time, geographic, magnitude and event-type parameters; response limit 20000.

sources.title: USGS ANSS ComCat documentation
sources.supports: ComCat combines contributing network source parameters; preferred values and catalog updates require caution.

sources.title: Nandan et al., Forecasting the full distribution of earthquake numbers is fair, robust and better
sources.supports: Clustering motivates caution about Poisson count distributions; paper compares full-distribution ETAS versus restricted mean-based evaluations. Our small occurrence baseline does not reproduce their ETAS experiment.
sources.access: full PDF accessible; abstract, introduction, methods and California data sections read; supplementary results not independently replicated
sources.version: arXiv 1903.07079v1, 2019-03-17; only v1 in submission history

sources.title: USGS Copyrights and Credits
sources.supports: USGS-produced data are US public domain; marked third-party content can have restrictions; credit USGS. No automatic CC0 attribution to all contributor products.

sources.title: USGS scientific data release policy FAQ
sources.supports: Public scientific data offered at no cost/public domain except restrictions; used with explicit credit and contributor provenance.

preflight.limitations: Bounded search, not exhaustive. Nandan HTML v2 and two guessed availability URLs failed; v1 PDF read instead. No event catalog ingested yet. No exact independent research resolution established. Data rights will be documented without inventing a CC0 grant for all contributors.
preflight.scope_comparison: A historical constant-Poisson daily-occurrence baseline in a fixed California-region rectangle is a narrow reproduction of the card first task. It cannot close occurrence/ground-motion/real-time warning or establish unseen-region calibration gains.
preflight.baseline: fit lambda = calibration event count / 365 days once; p = -expm1(-lambda); same p on all test days; no test refit
